item.title: Astellas Gene Therapy
item.description:
• Summary: Astellas' gene therapy offers new hope to the rare disease community, particularly for patients with myotubular myopathy. Clinical trials for the therapy have resumed after a pause, showing promising early results in treating this devastating neuromuscular disorder.
  • MoAs: AAV-mediated gene replacement therapy delivering a functional copy of the MTM1 gene to muscle cells, addressing the underlying genetic defect of myotubular myopathy.
  • Sources: STAT News, STAT News
